plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-12 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) General Studies program page (poid=10834) and its linked official degree map, 'General Studies (BA-BS) Degree Maps (2026-2027)', tab 'General Studies (Campus)', last updated/reviewed July 27, 2026 (the workbook's Online tab is identical in every row and total). Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Collected as the BS: the catalog prints a single combined Total Credits, BA/BS Degree: 120, and neither map includes the Bachelor of Arts degree requirement of 16 credits of one foreign language (the Online tab expressly notes that students electing the BA take 16 credits of one foreign language, which are not included in the map; the Campus tab carries no equivalent note). All courses must be passed with a C- (1.7) or better to be counted in the major (catalog program information). General Studies is a stand-alone program and cannot be used as a double major; graduates cannot be approved for Utah state certification as a teacher using this major; credit earned more than 20 years ago may be considered and, if approved, counted towards the major (catalog program information). Every semester's courses sum to the map's printed semester total (15 in all eight terms) and the plan to the catalog's printed Total Credits, BA/BS Degree: 120. The catalog curriculum reconciles exactly: General Studies Curriculum 49 = Required Course GS 4000 (3) plus General Studies Courses 46 (any transcripted courses meeting the minimum grade requirement, with a minimum of 24 credits of upper-division inclusive of GS 4000). The map's seven 'Major Upper-division Course' rows plus GS 4000 total exactly that 24-credit upper-division minimum; the remaining 22 credits of the 46-credit block sit inside the map's free-elective rows, recorded as printed (map free rows total 68: 50 Free Electives + 18 Free Upper-division Electives; the catalog prints no fixed free-elective figure). The map's General Education rows total 28 (seven 3-credit GE slots plus ENGL 1010, ENGL 2010 and the 1-credit INFO 1010), matching the catalog's General Education Requirement of 28+ credits.
